title: Adverbia et Negātiō
subtitle: Fōrmātiō adverbiōrum ab adiectīvīs (-ως), et discrīmen fundāmentāle inter negātiōnēs οὐ et μή.
objectives: Formāre adverbium ab adiectīvō classis prīmae, mūtandō -ν fīnāle genetīvī plūrālis in -ς
Recitāre trēs fōrmās negātiōnis οὐ (οὐ, οὐκ, οὐχ) et applicāre rēgulam orthographicam correctam
Distinguere ūsum fundāmentālem οὐ (negātiō factī, modō indicātīvō) ā μή (negātiō voluntātis/hypothesis, aliīs modīs)
Applicāre μή ad prohibitiōnēs simplicēs cum imperātīvō

content.intro: Ὁ διδάσκαλος καλῶς λέγει. Ἀγάθων λέγει· οὐκ ἐθέλω μένειν. Notāvistī: καλῶς (adverbium, “bene”) et οὐκ (negātiō)? Duo elementa parva sed frequentissima concludunt hunc gradum grammaticum praecipuum: quōmodo adverbia fōrmantur ab adiectīvīs iam nōtīs, et quōmodo Graecum ēligit inter οὐ et μή secundum grammaticam contextūs.
content.explanation:
Ὁ διδάσκαλος καλῶς λέγει· δικαίως καὶ σοφῶς ἄρχει. Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Οὐκ ἐθέλω μένειν.” Μελίτη λέγει· “Οὐχ ὁρῶ τὴν πόλιν.” Ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει· “Μὴ λύε τὸν δοῦλον.” (Magister bene loquitur; iūstē et sapienter regit. Agathōn dīcit: “Nōlō manēre.” Melitē dīcit: “Nōn videō urbem.” Magister dīcit: “Nōlī solvere servum.”)

Notāvistīne καλῶς, δικαίως, σοφῶς (adverbia in -ως) versus οὐκ, οὐχ, μή (trēs negātiōnēs dīversae)? Adverbium fōrmātur ab adiectīvō classis prīmae rēgulā simplicī: sūme genetīvum plūrālem (masculīnum/neutrum, quī semper fīnītur -ων), et mūta -ν fīnāle in -ς: καλός → gen. pl. καλῶν → adverbium καλῶς (“bene, pulchrē”). Discrīmen quod Latīnum nōn habet: Latīnum adhibet “nōn” ubīque; Graecum ēligit inter οὐ et μή secundum grammaticam contextūs — vidēbis rēgulās plēnās īnfrā.

rules.heading: a) Fōrmātiō Adverbiōrum
rules.body:
AdiectīvumGen. Pl.AdverbiumSēnsus
καλόςκαλῶνκαλῶςbene, pulchrē
σοφόςσοφῶνσοφῶςsapienter
δίκαιοςδικαίωνδικαίωςiūstē

Rēgula valet prō omnī adiectīvō classis prīmae, indepēndenter ā fōrmā fēminīnī (-η vs. -α) — sōlum genetīvus plūrālis masculīnus/neutrus (semper -ων) importat.

rules.heading: b) Οὐ, Οὐκ, Οὐχ: Rēgula Orthographica
rules.body: Οὐ mūtat fōrmam secundum sonum initiālem verbī sequentis, exāctē sīcut articulus Anglicus “a”/“an”: οὐ ante cōnsonantem (οὐ λύω), οὐκ ante vōcālem cum spīritū lēnī (οὐκ ἐθέλω), οὐχ ante vōcālem cum spīritū aspero (οὐχ ὁρῶ). Mūtātiō sequitur logicam eufōnicam: -κ (surdum) ante spīritum lēnem, -χ (aspīrātum, comparā θ/φ/χ ex Gradū I) ante spīritum asperum, quia aspīrātiō “concordat”.

rules.heading: c) Οὐ vs. Μή: Discrīmen Fundāmentāle
rules.body: Οὐ negat FACTA obiectīva, modō indicātīvō: οὐ λύω τὸν δοῦλον “nōn solvō servum” (āctiō rēalis, negāta). Μή negat voluntātem, hypothesim, commandum — omnia quae NŌN sunt affirmātiōnēs simplicēs dē factō: imperātīva (prohibitiō), optātīva, coniūnctīva, condiciōnēs, plēraeque īnfīnītīvī. Exemplum ūtile iam nunc: prohibitiō cum imperātīvō semper adhibet μή, numquam οὐ: μὴ λύε “nōlī solvere!”. Theoria plēna huius discrīminis (per omnēs modōs) sequitur cum coniūnctīvus/optātīvus/imperātīvus plēnē tractantur (Gradibus IV/V).

examples: ὁ διδάσκαλος καλῶς λέγει. — Magister bene loquitur. (adverbium ab adiectīvō)
οὐ λύω τὸν δοῦλον. — Nōn solvō servum. (negātiō factī, indicātīvus)
οὐκ ἐθέλω μένειν. — Nōlō manēre. (οὐκ ante spīritum lēnem)
οὐχ ὁρῶ τὴν πόλιν. — Nōn videō urbem. (οὐχ ante spīritum asperum)
μὴ λύε τὸν δοῦλον. — Nōlī solvere servum! (prohibitiō, imperātīvus + μή)
δικαίως καὶ σοφῶς ἄρχει. — Iūstē et sapienter regit. (duo adverbia coniūncta)

commonMistakes.wrong: Adhibēre οὐ ubīque, indepēndenter ā modō vel cōnstrūctiōne, imitandō ūnicam negātiōnem Latīnam “nōn”.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere: οὐ prō factīs (indicātīvus), μή prō voluntāte/hypothesī/commandō (aliī modī, imperātīvus, plērīque īnfīnītīvī).
commonMistakes.why: Latīnum habet ūnam sōlam negātiōnem prīncipālem (nōn); Graecum distinguit systēmaticē duo genera negātiōnis.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ignōrāre mūtātiōnem οὐ → οὐκ/οὐχ ante vōcālēs, scrībendō semper “οὐ” invariābiliter.
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre rēgulam eufōnicam: οὐκ ante spīritum lēnem, οὐχ ante spīritum asperum, οὐ ante cōnsonantem.
commonMistakes.why: Error orthographicus frequēns, comparābilis neglēctuī rēgulae ν ephelkystikon (Gradū I).

commonMistakes.wrong: Fōrmāre adverbium ex fōrmā fēminīnā adiectīvī (ut ex καλή) potius quam ex genetīvō plūrālī masculīnō/neutrō.
commonMistakes.right: Semper fōrmāre adverbium ā genetīvō plūrālī masculīnō/neutrō (-ων → -ως), indepēndenter ā fōrmā fēminīnī.
commonMistakes.why: Fōrma fēminīna nōn participat in fōrmātiōne adverbiī — sōlum genus masculīnum/neutrum importat hīc.

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine fōrmae.

items.explanation: Falsum: “οὐχ ὁρῶ τὴν πόλιν” significat “nōn videō urbem”.
“Μὴ λύε τὸν δοῦλον” est prohibitiō (μή + imperātīvus): “nōlī solvere”.

options: ā genetīvō plūrālī masculīnō/neutrō, mūtātō -ν in -ς

items.prompt: Quae fōrma adhibētur ante vōcālem cum spīritū aspero?
items.explanation: Οὐχ adhibētur ante spīritum asperum, propter concordantiam aspīrātiōnis.

items.prompt: Quae negātiō adhibētur cum imperātīvō in prohibitiōne?
items.explanation: Prohibitiō cum imperātīvō semper adhibet μή, numquam οὐ.
Οὐ est negātiō factī, adhibita cum modō indicātīvō.

items.statement: Graecum habet duās negātiōnēs prīncipālēs (οὐ, μή) cum ūsibus distīnctīs, ubi Latīnum habet sōlum “nōn”.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: discrīmen οὐ/μή nōn habet homologum simplicem in Latīnō.

items.statement: Adverbium fōrmātur ā fōrmā fēminīnā adiectīvī.
items.explanation: Falsum: fōrmātur ā genetīvō plūrālī masculīnō/neutrō.

items.statement: Οὐκ adhibētur ante cōnsonantem, οὐ ante vōcālem cum spīritū lēnī.
items.explanation: Falsum: inversum est vērum — οὐ ante cōnsonantem, οὐκ ante spīritum lēnem.

items.statement: Μή adhibētur typicē cum imperātīvō in prohibitiōnibus.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: μὴ λύε “nōlī solvere” exemplificat hunc ūsum.

summary: Adverbium: gen. pl. masc./neut. adiectīvī (-ων) → adverbium (-ως); καλός → καλῶν → καλῶς.
Οὐ (ante cōnsonantem), οὐκ (ante spīritum lēnem), οὐχ (ante spīritum asperum) — mūtātiō eufōnica obligātōria.
Οὐ negat facta obiectīva (indicātīvus); μή negat voluntātem/hypothesim/commandum (aliī modī).
Prohibitiō cum imperātīvō semper adhibet μή, numquam οὐ (μὴ λύε “nōlī solvere”).
Theoria plēna οὐ/μή per omnēs modōs sequitur cum coniūnctīvus/optātīvus/imperātīvus plēnē tractantur.
